channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Edinho Silva diz que eleição é 'contra a milícia' e anuncia mobilização nacional para o dia 27
item.description: Edinho Silva, national president of the PT, stated that the 2026 election is a contest between those who strengthen institutions and those leading militias, indirectly referencing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). He announced a national mobilization for the 27th, reinforcing the party's stance in defense of democratic institutions.

item.title: Lula aposta tarde contra desgraça das 'bets' e da vida cara para o povo miúdo
item.description: President Lula is expected to issue a provisional measure restricting online sports betting, aiming to attract undecided voters. The move is viewed as a late attempt to gain votes and may be seen as opportunistic by segments already vocal about the issue.

item.title: A nova pesquisa presidencial no segundo maior colégio eleitoral do Nordeste
item.description: A new Real Time Big Data poll will be released on September 28, measuring voter intent in Pernambuco for the 2026 presidential election. The survey will test spontaneous and stimulated voting scenarios with 14 candidates, including a potential runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, and assess approval of President Lula's administration. Data collection runs from September 23–26 with 1,600 interviews and a maximum error margin of 2.5 percentage points.

item.title: Haddad diz que 2026 “não está fácil” e ataca extrema-direita durante evento
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) stated that the 2026 election race is not getting easier and labeled the far-right as a 'political pathology,' specifically attacking Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged ties to militias and misconduct. He spoke at a São Paulo event alongside Geraldo Alckmin and Marina Silva, emphasizing the need to unite progressive forces to defeat former president Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: "Privatização da Sabesp precisa ser investigada", diz Alckmin com Haddad
item.description: Interim president Geraldo Alckmin called for an investigation into the privatization of Sabesp, criticizing former São Paulo governor Tarcísio's management and highlighting deteriorations in security, education, and increased corruption. He praised Lula's federal administration, noting reductions in inflation, deforestation, and unemployment, along with export records.

item.title: Justiça rejeita pedido de Lulinha para remover vídeo de Zema
item.description: The São Paulo State Court denied the request filed by Lula's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), to remove an AI-generated video posted by former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema. The court refused the preliminary injunction, keeping the content online.

item.title: Casos de violência política de gênero crescem 11 vezes em 4 anos
item.description: Political gender-based violence in Brazil has increased more than 11 times in four years, with 177 cases sent to Electoral Justice by September 2026, compared to only 15 in 2022. The TSE and MPF launched the campaign 'Politics is a Feminine Noun' to combat this issue, which silences and drives women out of political life. Cases such as the assassination of Marielle Franco and attacks on Maria do Rosário illustrate the severity of the violence.

item.title: Alckmin diz que “Lula vai agir firme contra as bets”
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will take firm action against online betting platforms to support the popular economy. His remarks were made during a political mobilization event in São Paulo, following Lula's announcement to ban casino games and restrict sports betting. Football clubs oppose the measure and are seeking a meeting with the president to block the changes.

item.title: Moraes arquiva investigação contra ex-diretores da PRF acusados de tentar impedir deslocamento de eleitores em 2022
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes dismissed the investigation into three former directors of the federal highway police accused of trying to hinder voters during the 2022 elections. The decision, favoring Djairlon Henrique Moura, Luis Carlos Reischak Junior, and Rodrigo Cardozo Hoppe, was based on the Attorney General's assessment that there were insufficient grounds to prosecute them.

item.title: Bingo do Lula na ONU: o que ele disse e o que ficou de fora
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva used the UN General Assembly to advance campaign proposals, highlighting issues such as the Pix payment system, femicide prevention, and criticism of military escalation. His speech received applause in the plenary, but leaders like Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin remained absent from New York. Analysts from Papo Antagonista assessed the speech as a showcase of multilateralism supported by the BRICS.

item.title: Haddad diz que Flávio é “muito novo” para ter “currículo tão podre”
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at a mobilization event in São Paulo, calling him 'too young' to have such a 'weak track record' and questioning his public profile, including investigations at the Supreme Court and use of parliamentary amendments. The candidate highlighted controversial actions of the senator, including a case involving funding for the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: A reação de Augusto Cury após cair nas pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: Augusto Cury disputed the drop in his polls, claiming street perception differs and predicting a 'big surprise' on October 4th. He also suspects social media algorithms are limiting his campaign's reach.

item.title: Um uísque de Vorcaro para Lula?
item.description: Lawyer Walfrido Warde, former legal team member of Daniel Vorcaro, conveyed an embrace from President Lula after a meeting, according to messages published by O Globo. The conversations suggest a gift of whiskey from Vorcaro to Lula, raising questions about potential favors and influence relations.

item.title: Quaest mostra ampla vantagem de Lula sobre Flávio Bolsonaro na Paraíba
item.description: The Quaest survey, commissioned by TV Cabo Branco and Paraíba, shows Lula (PT) leading with 54% of voting intentions in the first round, against 23% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), based on interviews with 804 voters between September 18 and 21, 2026. Lula also holds a strong lead in the simulated second round with 60%.

item.title: Lula ataca big techs na ONU, mas abre dados do Brasil à China
item.description: Lula criticised Big Tech and digital neoliberalism at the UN, yet drew Brazil closer to Chinese AI initiatives within the BRICS framework. Columnist Márcio Coimbra pointed out the contradiction between anti-corporate rhetoric and alignment with China. The stance reflects the global power play between the US and China.

item.title: Mensagens de Vorcaro mostram advogado articulando aproximação de banqueiro com governo: ‘Estive com o presidente Lula longamente ontem. Vc vai gostar’
item.description: Phone records seized by the Federal Police from Daniel Vorcaro show his lawyer Walfrido Warde arranged meetings between the banker and President Lula, using former chief of staff Marco Aurélio 'Marcola' as an intermediary, to bring the Banco Master closer to the federal government. Warde claimed to have spoken with Lula and attempted to channel the bank’s interests through formal communications to the Planalto. Vorcaro, whose bank was under regulatory pressure, sought to align with the Lula administration to reduce criticism from the PT.

item.title: Veja como foi a terça-feira (22) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Tuesday (22nd), presidential candidates held campaign activities such as walks, parades, and rallies. Lula emphasized Brazilian sovereignty at the UN, while Flávio Bolsonaro promised infrastructure investments for agribusiness in São Luís. Candidates like Clariana Barão, Edmilson Costa, Hertz Dias, and Romeu Zema also had public agendas.

item.title: Lula usa a tribuna da ONU para fazer campanha a 12 dias da eleição
item.description: Lula used the UN podium to deliver a politically charged speech 12 days ahead of the 2026 elections, advocating democracy against negationism and revisiting the issue of corruption. The speech was seen as a campaign move, emphasizing a progressive stance aligned with topics such as combating misinformation.

item.title: A opinião de Augusto Cury sobre impeachment de ministros do STF
item.description: Augusto Cury, Avante's presidential candidate, stated that STF ministers should face impeachment if corruption is proven and advocates for judicial reforms, including eight-year terms without reappointment and diversified selection of justices. He criticizes the STF's overreach and prioritizes issues like education and urban regularization.

item.title: Marina Silva diz que discurso de Lula na ONU é “documento histórico”
item.description: Marina Silva praised Lula's UN speech, calling it a historic document and highlighting the defense of sovereignty and multipolarity. The Senate candidate emphasized the president's moral and political courage in positioning Brazil against foreign influence. The event included participation from PT leaders and allies.

item.title: Lula faz gestos aos Calheiros e a João Campos com incursão no Nordeste
item.description: President Lula visits Alagoas and Pernambuco to support allies like João Campos and Renan Filho in local elections amid tight races. His gestures aim to strengthen the PT's base and partners in the Northeast region.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos a deputado federal pelo Rio Grande do Sul (RS) nas eleições 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, 458 candidates compete for 31 seats in the Chamber of Deputies from Rio Grande do Sul. The proportional system defines the election, with a single round on October 4th.

item.title: Candidatos à Presidência lamentam morte do cantor sertanejo Rick
item.description: Presidential candidates mourned the death of singer Rick Sollo and five others in a helicopter crash in the Serra Catarinense. Figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Romeu Zema, Augusto Cury, and Ronaldo Caiado paid tribute to the victims' families on social media. The crash also claimed the lives of the entrepreneur and pilots.

item.title: Augusto Cury: ‘Modelo de Lula está falido e de Flávio também, se o pai perdeu, o filho também vai perder’
item.description: Augusto Cury, Avante's presidential candidate, stated that the economic models of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are bankrupt and ruled out supporting either opponent. He expressed his intention to reach the second round to 'retire' Lula and criticized the experience of both main rivals in economy and agriculture.

item.title: Advogado de Vorcaro diz que banqueiro presenteou Lula: ‘agradeceu mais uma vez o whisky’
item.description: Lawyer Walfrido Warde, former defender of Daniel Vorcaro, claimed in a WhatsApp message that the banker gifted President Lula a whiskey, noting that the president thanked him and sent a hug. The conversation occurred 49 days after the meeting between Lula and Vorcaro at the Planalto Palace in December 2024. The information was published as an exclusive subscriber-only article.

item.title: EUA barram China de participar de consulta na OMC sobre tarifaço contra o Brasil
item.description: The United States blocked China from joining the WTO consultation on the tariff imposed on Brazil. The US government deemed China's claim of commercial interest unfounded. Talks at the WTO begin on Friday.

item.title: Veja lista dos candidatos a deputado estadual no Pará (PA) em 2026
item.description: The list of candidates for state deputy in Pará for 2026 is available on the TSE website with their electoral name, party, and registration status.

item.title: Veja lista dos candidatos a deputado federal pelo Paraná em 2026
item.description: The list of candidates for federal deputy in Paraná in 2026 can be checked on the TSE portal, including ballot name, number, party, and electoral court status. Official information is released by the Superior Electoral Court.

item.title: Veja lista dos candidatos a deputado estadual no Paraná em 2026
item.description: The list of candidates for state deputy in Paraná for 2026 is available on the TSE website, including ballot name, number, party, and Electoral Court status. The publication enables real-time tracking of candidate registrations. No specific candidate names are mentioned in the provided content.

item.title: Veja lista dos candidatos a deputado federal na Bahia em 2026
item.description: The list of candidates for federal deputy in Bahia for 2026 is available on the TSE portal, containing details such as ballot name, number, party, and electoral court status.

item.title: PT prepara mobilização nacional pró-Lula uma semana antes da eleição
item.description: The PT is preparing a national pro-Lula mobilization for September 27, one week before the elections. The call was made by Edinho Silva during a plenary session in São Paulo, urging supporters to take to the streets and social media. The event included participation from allies such as Geraldo Alckmin and Fernando Haddad.

item.title: Análise: Lula assume ingrato papel entre o pessimismo e a implosão da ONU
item.description: Lula advocated for multilateral diplomacy at the UN, opposing Trump and Guterres. He highlighted the organization's crisis and the need to resolve conflicts without weapons.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro é internada com quadro de enxaqueca
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former First Lady and Senate candidate from PL-DF, was hospitalized at Hospital DF Star in Brasília with refractory migraine after failing outpatient treatment. According to the medical report, she remains under specialized clinical care with no discharge date set. Despite her hospitalization, she leads Senate vote intentions in the Federal District at 26%, per a survey released in September 2026.

item.title: Caiado fala em resgatar territórios no combate ao crime organizado: 'Soberania brasileira hoje está entregue'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) proposes to reclaim territories in the fight against organized crime by labeling factions as terrorists and strengthening border protection. He asserts that Brazilian sovereignty is compromised and rejects any foreign interference.

item.title: Filhos da Nação: projeto do DF conquista pódios em Campeonato de Canoagem
item.description: The Filhos da Nação project from Brasília won multiple medals at the 2026 Brasília Va’a Marathon Championship, standing out with victories in the OC6 Junior 19 categories. Created in 2017, the project offers free outrigger canoe and stand-up paddle lessons, serving over 480 youths from public schools and promoting personal and social development.

item.title: Brasil chega à eleição sob interferência ativa dos EUA, avalia ex-embaixador
item.description: Brazil heads to 2026 elections amid allegations of active U.S. interference, particularly from Secretary of State Marco Rubio, according to former ambassador Roberto Abdenur. Lula delivers a balanced speech at the UN, while Trump threatens Latin America with military force.

item.title: Novo triplica candidatos, abre os cofres e projeta gastar mais de R$ 70 milhões na eleição
item.description: The Partido Novo tripled its number of candidates and projects spending over R$ 70 million in the 2026 election, betting on experienced names to strengthen its parliamentary group. After failing to clear the electoral threshold in 2022, the party aims to elect between 15 and 20 federal deputies and will now use public funding, breaking with its tradition of relying solely on private donations.

item.title: Lula é tietado na ONU, enquanto Trump volta a ser alvo de protestos
item.description: At the 81st UN General Assembly, President Lula emphasized sovereignty and criticized foreign interference, while Trump highlighted U.S. supremacy. Tensions between the two leaders intensified due to a media boycott of the event.

item.title: Tarcísio declara apoio e pede voto para Cleitinho: “Parceria vai dar certo”
item.description: São Paulo governor and re-election candidate Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) publicly endorsed Minas Gerais senator Cleitinho Azevedo in the race for state governor, urging voters to support him in a video released September 22. The alliance strengthens ties within the state’s right-wing movement and aims to boost Cleitinho’s campaign, who leads the polls and targets a first-round win. The partnership also underscores Tarcísio’s administration as a model for public security, infrastructure, and investment attraction for the Minas Gerais ticket.

item.title: Quaest na Paraíba: Lula, 54%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 23%
item.description: Quaest poll in Paraíba shows Lula with 54% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 23% in the first round, with 60% and 26% in the second round. Government approval for Lula in PB is 62%, with 32% disapproval.

item.title: Quaest na Paraíba: 64% aprovam e 16% desaprovam governo de Lucas Ribeiro (PP)
item.description: A Quaest survey released on September 22, 2026 shows that 64% of Paraibans approve of Governor Lucas Ribeiro's administration, while 16% disapprove. The main concern among voters is violence, mentioned by 33% of respondents.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro aparecem empatados em novas pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: Recent polls show Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) technically tied in both the first and second rounds, with differences within the margin of error. In the BTG/Nexus survey, Lula leads with 40% against Flávio's 37% in the first round, while the Quaest survey shows Lula with 37% and Flávio with 33%. In the second round, both institutes indicate a technical tie, with only a one-point difference between the candidates.

item.title: Quaest na PB: Lucas Ribeiro, 49%; Efraim Filho, 16%; Cícero Lucena, 15%
item.description: A Quaest poll commissioned by TV Cabo Branco and Paraíba, released on September 22, 2026, shows Lucas Ribeiro (PP) leading the race for governor of Paraíba with 49% in the preferential vote, followed by Efraim Filho (PL) at 16% and Cícero Lucena (MDB) at 15%. The poll, valid for the first round, surveyed 804 people from September 18–21, with a margin of error of three percentage points and 64% approval rating for Lucas Ribeiro's government. Simulations for the second round were also conducted, maintaining Lucas Ribeiro with strong winning prospects.

item.title: VEJA BRASÍLIA COMER & BEBER 2026: confira os finalistas de Comidinhas
item.description: The new edition of VEJA BRASÍLIA COMER & BEBER will be released on October 1st, awarding establishments across 17 categories including food kiosks. The winners will be announced at an event at the Royal Tulip Brasília Alvorada, covered live on Instagram.

item.title: Lula tem 60,5% contra 32,7% de Flávio no 2º turno em PE, diz pesquisa
item.description: A poll by AtlasIntel released on September 22, 2026, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 60.5% of voting intentions against 32.7% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a potential runoff in Pernambuco. Among valid votes, Lula reaches 64.9% and Flávio, 35.1%. The survey interviewed 1,836 voters between September 15 and 20, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

item.title: Aliados de Moraes preparam nova ofensiva contra Nunes Marques para evitar voto em caso sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Allies of Moraes at the STF prepare an offensive against Nunes Marques to prevent him from voting in cases involving Vorcaro. They threaten to expose relations of the minister and his son with the banker, including leaked messages. Nunes Marques has already declared himself hindered and intends to resume voting after the second round of elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE registra 177 processos de violência política de gênero este ano
item.description: The TSE recorded 177 cases of political gender-based violence in 2026, with highlights in the Southeast (63 cases) and São Paulo (29). The initiative aims to raise awareness about underreporting and protect female politicians from threats, harassment, and persecution.

item.title: Imprensa internacional destaca discurso de Lula na ONU
item.description: President Lula emphasized multilateralism and UN Security Council reform at the UN, warning against foreign interference in elections. His speech was applauded as he reaffirmed Brazilian sovereignty and condemned the enslavement of Africans as a crime against humanity.

item.title: Lula mantém economia em terreno positivo, mas dívida das famílias ainda é problema
item.description: The Brazilian economy shows indicators favorable to Lula's reelection, such as inflation below the target ceiling, low unemployment, and interest rate cuts. However, high credit costs and GDP slowdown create uncertainties about the recovery of families' purchasing power.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro encontra jornalista alvo de Moraes em São Luís
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with journalist Luís Pablo Almeida in São Luís during a campaign event. Almeida is under investigation at the STF following the publication of reports involving Minister Flávio Dino. The meeting takes place amid political polarization.
